title: Diedre's Queue
html:
Liza Beth------------Kentucky Jim---------Billy Ray--Diedre

In Dew Valley, one of the first sights you encounter (and if you don't notice it, the Helpful Noobosaur points it out to you) is the Queue waiting for "Technical Assistance"! This is DR's small jab at certain other games.

By fulfilling a series of Quests you can work your way up through the NPC's in line, Liza Beth, Kentucky Jim and Billy Ray, and finally reach Diedre the Resourceful at the head of the line! These quests familiarize the newbie with many facets of the game.
